initialInputs.amountEncoding: positive decimal string, maximum 128 characters and 32 fraction digits
initialInputs.empty: clear detail rows; preserve fallback date

annual.transactionFilter: SYNCED with syncedAt after initial import; no pre-import double count
annual.cashFlowDates: tradeDate under explicit user accounting assumption
annual.terminalFlow: +YJB market value on official NAV belonging date
annual.initialHistoryAssumption: User inputs model retained initial cost; pre-import sales/dividends ignored by request
annual.overall: merge fund flows; active valuation dates must align; never average rates
annual.cashPrecision: BigDecimal; normalized Double only for numerical rate solving

cumulative: YJB value + post-import SYNCED sell net proceeds - imported cost - post-import SYNCED buy amounts
realized: post-import SYNCED SELL calculatedProfit: net proceeds minus baseline cost of sold shares
cumulativeRate: cumulativeProfit / (imported cost + post-import SYNCED buy amounts)
holdingOrigin: earliest complete detail date or fallback date, and SYNCED BUY confirmedNavDate; never navConfirmedAt/syncedAt
completenessGuard: initial observation + SYNCED normalized targets must explain current YJB shares/unit cost; external changes block local statistics only
persistence: existing Keystore encrypted app-private atomic initial-import storage; optional JSON field; no Room migration
display: HALF_UP 2 digits; raw decimal fields retain unlocalized precision
